'''Janwin''' is the [[clan chief]] of the [[Shiande]] [[Aiel]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has a fierce creased face, blue-gray eyes, and gray hair.

== History ==
Janwin is of the [[Degalle]] sept. He is married to the [[roofmistress]] [[Corida]]. The [[Wise One]] [[Baellin]] is in service to him.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Janwin}}

== Activities ==
His clan joins [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces after the [[Shaido]] siege of [[Cairhien]]. He now occupies Cairhien. When Rand was kidnapped by [[White Tower]] Aes Sedai the bleakness hits his clan hard.

Rand uses [[Merana Ambrey]] as a servant to convince Janwin that he is not an [[Aes Sedai]] puppet in the hope Janwin will continue to support him.
